inbox.title: You're all caught up
inbox.body: New messages will show up here.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: Your mail shows up here once the connection is back.

noAccount.title: No mailbox yet
noAccount.body: Add a mailbox to see your mail.

empty.title: No message selected
empty.body: Select a message to read it.

reader.remoteBlocked: Remote images are blocked to protect your privacy.
reader.remoteTrustedAddress: Images from {{email}} will load from now on
reader.remoteTrustedDomain: Images from {{domain}} will load from now on
reader.remoteLoadingAddress: Images load because {{email}} is on your list
reader.remoteLoadingDomain: Images load because {{domain}} is on your list
reader.appearanceShowLight: Show this mail in light colors.
reader.appearanceShowDark: Show this mail in dark colors.
reader.appearanceAutoLight: Kept light automatically because this mail has a lot of its own design.
reader.appearanceNative: This mail brings its own dark design.
reader.appearanceRemembered: Applies to all mail from {{email}} from now on

error.title: Couldn't load this message
error.body: Check your connection and try again.

toast.draftLocal: The draft is only saved on this device. UwUMail will try again later.
toast.sendUndone: Sending stopped. You can keep writing.
toast.undoTooLate: Too late, the mail is already on its way.
toast.sendFailedKept: The mail couldn't be sent: {{reason}} It's waiting in Drafts.
toast.blocked: {{entry}} is blocked. New mail from there goes to the trash.
toast.unsubscribePage: {{name}}'s unsubscribe page is open in your browser

status.demo: Demo mode. Sample data, nothing is sent.

onboarding.welcomeBody: A mail client for everyone. Three short steps and you're ready.
onboarding.layoutBody: You can change this any time in settings.
onboarding.toneBody: Changes the words, never the features.
onboarding.accountBody: Enter your address. UwUMail finds the server settings for you.
onboarding.doneBody: Your mail is loading in the background.

simple.name: Simple
simple.desc: Two columns, big rows, fewer buttons.

pro.name: Pro
pro.desc: Folders always visible, three columns, keyboard shortcuts.

playful.name: Playful
playful.desc: Kaomoji, little jokes and cute messages.

neutral.name: Neutral
neutral.desc: Clear and plain. Same app, calmer words.

account.name: Your name
account.guessed: These settings are a best guess. Check them if connecting fails.
account.oauthHint: {{provider}} asks you to sign in on their website. Your password never passes through UwUMail.
account.appPasswordHint: Using two-factor authentication? Many providers need an app password here.
account.errorAuth: The server rejected the username or password.
account.errorConnection: Couldn't connect to the server. Check the address and your internet connection.
account.errorInvalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
account.errorOauthDemo: Sign-in with {{provider}} needs the desktop app.
account.protocolJmapHint: Your server speaks JMAP: faster, lighter on data, and new mail arrives instantly.
account.protocolImapHint: The classic way. You can switch to JMAP later in the settings.
account.jmapUrlHint: Usually https://your-server/.well-known/jmap. Leave empty for IMAP only.
account.fastmailTokenHint: Fastmail needs an API token here: Settings › Privacy & Security › Manage API tokens, with access to mail and sending.
account.cleartextBody: Your password and mail travel readable through the network. Only use this for a server in your own network.

settings.title: Settings
settings.listDensityDesc: Compact fits more mail on screen, with a small picture and two lines.
settings.motionDesc: With System, UwUMail follows the reduced motion setting of your operating system.
settings.conversationsDesc: Replies appear together with the message they answer.
settings.remoteImagesDesc: Remote images can tell senders when and where you opened a message.
settings.trustedSendersDesc: A company like @shop.com covers all of its addresses, including news@ or noreply@.
settings.trustedSendersEmpty: Nobody yet. You add senders right in the image notice of a message.
settings.trustedSendersInactive: Only applies with “Ask every time”. Right now UwUMail loads all images.
settings.removeAccountConfirm: Remove {{email}} from UwUMail? Mail on the server isn't touched.
settings.addonsEmptyBody: Addons add features like snooze, templates or encryption. They can only use what you allow.
settings.addonsSoon: The addon catalog opens with version 0.1.
settings.license: Free software under the GNU GPL v3.0.
settings.mailAppearanceDesc: Automatic darkens simple mails and keeps elaborately designed newsletters light. Plain text always follows the app theme.
settings.senderPicturesDesc: Shows the brand logo or website icon of companies. UwUMail asks each company's website once a month, never per mail. People at mail providers like Gmail keep their initials.
settings.protocolSwitchConfirm: Switch {{email}} to {{protocol}}? UwUMail downloads the mail again for that.
settings.runInBackground: Keep running in the notification area
settings.runInBackgroundDesc: Closing the window leaves UwUMail next to the clock, so new mail still arrives. Quit it from its icon there.
settings.updatesDesc: UwUMail downloads new versions quietly and installs them the next time it starts.
settings.channelBetaDesc: Beta gets new features earlier, and sometimes a rough edge.
settings.swipeDesc: What happens when you swipe a mail in the list.
settings.appLockDesc: Ask for fingerprint, face or PIN when UwUMail opens.
settings.appLockUnavailable: Set up a screen lock on your phone first.
settings.backgroundPush: Tell me about new mail right away
settings.backgroundPushDesc: UwUMail stays connected in the background. Android shows a quiet, lasting notification for that, which you can hide.
settings.offlineDaysDesc: Newer mail is stored completely on the phone and can be read and searched offline. Older mail only with sender, subject and preview; its content loads when you open it.
settings.undoSendDesc: How long you can still take a sent mail back. It goes out even if you close the window meanwhile.
settings.sendersDesc: The addresses you can write from. JMAP mailboxes bring more addresses from the server; otherwise add your aliases here. Replies go out from the address the mail was sent to.
settings.signaturesDesc: Per sender address, with bold, links and pictures. Add several and choose which one is added to new mail and which one to replies.
settings.signaturesEmpty: There's no signature for this address yet.
settings.signatureImageFailed: The picture couldn't be added. Use a PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP under 8 MB.
settings.blockedSendersDesc: New mail from these addresses and domains goes straight to the trash. Block someone from “More” in a mail.

attachment.noPreview: No preview for this file type
attachment.noPreviewBody: Open it with an app on your computer or save it.
attachment.pdfHint: Not showing up? Open it with your PDF app.
attachment.dangerTitle: This file can run programs on your computer
attachment.dangerBody: {{name}} comes from {{sender}}. Files like this are a common way to install malware. Only open it if you expected it and trust the sender.
attachment.notPdf: This file says it's a PDF but isn't one, so it isn't shown here. Save it or open it with an app if you trust it.
attachment.packageBlocked: UwUMail doesn't open app packages from mails. Save the file to Downloads if you expected it and trust the sender.

link.warningBody: The text shows a different address than where the link leads. Phishing mail often works like this.

lock.title: UwUMail is locked
lock.body: Unlock with your fingerprint, face or your phone's PIN.

share.tooBig: {{names}} is too big for a mail and wasn't attached.

serverSearch.button: Also search older mail on the server
serverSearch.nothingMore: The server has no further matches.

move.title: Move to …
move.mixedAccounts: Mail from different mailboxes can only be moved one mailbox at a time.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from {{name}}?
unsubscribe.body: UwUMail unsubscribes you with the sender directly. After that, no more mail should come from there.
unsubscribe.bodyPage: The sender has its own page for this. UwUMail opens it for you, and you confirm there.
